name: agentcrm
description: A local first, open source CRM built for agent workflows

scripts.setup: npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm install --prefix apps/server --no-audit --no-fund && npm install --prefix apps/web --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix apps/server" "npm run dev --prefix apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix apps/server && npm run build --prefix apps/web
